notes.title: Georgie and Me Demo now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I'm very excited to announce that the demo for Georgie and Me is now live!
This demo includes a unique level built just for you to get a taste of what's to come.
In the full game, you will experience hell and high water just like this, so recognize if you are primed for these unrelenting gauntlets in your future!

Thank you all and have a blast!
- CD Jones

Twitter: @BestMilkshake
